title: Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door
description: A classic story unfolds on Nintendo Switch. With a map from Princess Peach and the help of a colorful cast of locals, Mario journeys across a paper-crafted world to collect the Crystal Stars before the X-Nauts and uncover the mystery behind the Thousand-Year Door.

contents.label: Timing-based turn-based battles with badges and special moves
Paper abilities for traversal such as plane, tube, and boat forms
Revamped graphics, updated soundtrack, and quality-of-life additions

gameplayPillars.title: Action Commands and badges
gameplayPillars.description: Master timing-based attacks and defenses, then customize builds by equipping badges.

gameplayPillars.title: Paper traversal abilities
gameplayPillars.description: Use paper transformations to glide, squeeze through gaps, and reach hidden areas.

gameplayPillars.title: Storybook exploration
gameplayPillars.description: Travel from Rogueport to themed regions while collecting Crystal Stars and recruiting partners.

gameplayPillars.title: Audience-based stage battles
gameplayPillars.description: Turn-based combat plays out on a stage, where timing, Stylish moves, partner abilities, and audience reactions add flair and mechanical depth.

gameplayPillars.title: Partners, badges, and build variety
gameplayPillars.description: Different partner skills and Badge combinations let players tune Mario's approach, creating more strategy than the series' papercraft visuals first suggest.

worldSummary: Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door mixes theatrical turn-based combat, exploration, witty writing, and memorable partner characters inside a handcrafted paper world spanning towns, dungeons, arenas, and cursed abilities.

storyChapters.title: Search for the Crystal Stars
storyChapters.body: Mario follows Peach’s map and races the X-Nauts to legendary treasure.

storyChapters.title: Meet a colorful cast
storyChapters.body: Partners like Goombella, Koops, Flurrie, Yoshi, and others help Mario in and out of battle.

storyChapters.title: Uncover the Thousand-Year Door mystery
storyChapters.body: As the story advances, the truth behind the ancient door and its treasure gradually unfolds.

storyChapters.title: Search for Crystal Stars across Rogueport's worlds
storyChapters.body: Mario travels from Rogueport into varied chapters and themed locations while pursuing the Crystal Stars and unraveling a larger mystery.

storyChapters.title: Partners and chapter twists drive the journey
storyChapters.body: Each chapter introduces memorable characters, self-contained arcs, and tonal variety that make the adventure one of Nintendo's most beloved RPGs.

features: Timing-based turn-based battles with badges and special moves
Paper abilities for traversal such as plane, tube, and boat forms
Revamped graphics, updated soundtrack, and quality-of-life additions
Excellent chapter structure keeps the adventure memorable
Badge system allows flexible builds and experimentation
Partners remain central both in battle and in exploration

faq.q: Is Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door single-player only?
faq.a: Yes. This remake is a single-player RPG adventure.
Yes. Nintendo lists it as Supported – game behavior is consistent with Nintendo Switch.

faq.q: What is new in the Nintendo Switch version?
faq.a: The remake features revamped graphics, an updated soundtrack, quick-travel improvements, and additions like the Partner Ring.

faq.q: Does The Thousand-Year Door have deep RPG customization?
faq.a: Yes. The Badge system, partner abilities, and resource management give the game more build flexibility and mechanical depth than many lighter Mario spin-offs.

faq.q: Why is this game so highly regarded?
faq.a: It is widely praised for its writing, chapter design, combat depth, humor, and memorable cast, all of which help it stand out in Nintendo's RPG catalog.
